QuestInfo.name: Fight for the Missing 2
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #p9390366#. He must know something.
QuestInfo.2: You drove away #p9390364# and freed the people. #p9390366# thinks that Arkarium headed to Magatia. Go check it out.

1.0: Good. There's not much time, so I'll cut to the chase.

yes.0: The mysterious mage was last seen headed towards Magatia.
yes.1: I escaped a couple days ago, but I'm sure that's where they were going. You can fly, right? I bet you can still reach them in time.
yes.2: I wish I knew more, but we were blindfolded when we were being moved. You're just lucky my hearing is so good...
yes.3: That's it. You and I both know there isn't much time. Get to #mMagatia#!

npc.0: You must defeat #p9390364# and rescue us. Not only is it heroic, it's also the only way to find out what you need to know!
